tvam agne dyubhis tvam āśuśukṣaṇis tvam adbhyas tvam aśmanas pari | [2.001.01a]

tvām agna ādityāsa āsya1ṁ tvāṁ jihvāṁ śucayaś cakrire kave | [2.001.13a]

abhi tvā naktīr uṣaso vavāśire 'gne vatsaṁ na svasareṣu dhenavaḥ | [2.002.02a]

huve vaḥ sudyotmānaṁ suvṛktiṁ viśām agnim atithiṁ suprayasam | [2.004.01a]

trī ṣadhasthā sindhavas triḥ kavīnām uta trimātā vidatheṣu samrāṭ | [3.056.05a]
ṛtāvarīr yoṣaṇās tisro apyās trir ā divo vidathe patyamānāḥ || [3.056.05c]

trir ā divaḥ savitar vāryāṇi dive-diva ā suva trir no ahnaḥ | [3.056.06a]
tridhātu rāya ā suvā vasūni bhaga trātar dhiṣaṇe sātaye dhāḥ || [3.056.06c]

trir ā divaḥ savitā soṣavīti rājānā mitrāvaruṇā supāṇī | [3.056.07a]
āpaś cid asya rodasī cid urvī ratnam bhikṣanta savituḥ savāya || [3.056.07c]

trir uttamā dūṇaśā rocanāni trayo rājanty asurasya vīrāḥ | [3.056.08a]
ṛtāvāna iṣirā dūḻabhāsas trir ā divo vidathe santu devāḥ || [3.056.08c]

pra me vivikvām̐ avidan manīṣāṁ dhenuṁ carantīm prayutām agopām | [3.057.01a]
sadyaś cid yā duduhe bhūri dhāser indras tad agniḥ panitāro asyāḥ || [3.057.01c]

indraḥ su pūṣā vṛṣaṇā suhastā divo na prītāḥ śaśayaṁ duduhre | [3.057.02a]
viśve yad asyāṁ raṇayanta devāḥ pra vo 'tra vasavaḥ sumnam aśyām || [3.057.02c]

yā jāmayo vṛṣṇa icchanti śaktiṁ namasyantīr jānate garbham asmin | [3.057.03a]
acchā putraṁ dhenavo vāvaśānā mahaś caranti bibhrataṁ vapūṁṣi || [3.057.03c]

acchā vivakmi rodasī sumeke grāvṇo yujāno adhvare manīṣā | [3.057.04a]
imā u te manave bhūrivārā ūrdhvā bhavanti darśatā yajatrāḥ || [3.057.04c]

yā te jihvā madhumatī sumedhā agne deveṣūcyata urūcī | [3.057.05a]
tayeha viśvām̐ avase yajatrān ā sādaya pāyayā cā madhūni || [3.057.05c]

yā te agne parvatasyeva dhārāsaścantī pīpayad deva citrā | [3.057.06a]
tām asmabhyam pramatiṁ jātavedo vaso rāsva sumatiṁ viśvajanyām || [3.057.06c]

dhenuḥ pratnasya kāmyaṁ duhānāntaḥ putraś carati dakṣiṇāyāḥ | [3.058.01a]
ā dyotaniṁ vahati śubhrayāmoṣasaḥ stomo aśvināv ajīgaḥ || [3.058.01c]

suyug vahanti prati vām ṛtenordhvā bhavanti pitareva medhāḥ | [3.058.02a]
jarethām asmad vi paṇer manīṣāṁ yuvor avaś cakṛmā yātam arvāk || [3.058.02c]

suyugbhir aśvaiḥ suvṛtā rathena dasrāv imaṁ śṛṇutaṁ ślokam adreḥ | [3.058.03a]
kim aṅga vām praty avartiṁ gamiṣṭhāhur viprāso aśvinā purājāḥ || [3.058.03c]

ā manyethām ā gataṁ kac cid evair viśve janāso aśvinā havante | [3.058.04a]
imā hi vāṁ goṛjīkā madhūni pra mitrāso na dadur usro agre || [3.058.04c]

tiraḥ purū cid aśvinā rajāṁsy āṅgūṣo vām maghavānā janeṣu | [3.058.05a]
eha yātam pathibhir devayānair dasrāv ime vāṁ nidhayo madhūnām || [3.058.05c]

purāṇam okaḥ sakhyaṁ śivaṁ vāṁ yuvor narā draviṇaṁ jahnāvyām | [3.058.06a]
punaḥ kṛṇvānāḥ sakhyā śivāni madhvā madema saha nū samānāḥ || [3.058.06c]

aśvinā vāyunā yuvaṁ sudakṣā niyudbhiṣ ca sajoṣasā yuvānā | [3.058.07a]
nāsatyā tiroahnyaṁ juṣāṇā somam pibatam asridhā sudānū || [3.058.07c]

aśvinā pari vām iṣaḥ purūcīr īyur gīrbhir yatamānā amṛdhrāḥ | [3.058.08a]
ratho ha vām ṛtajā adrijūtaḥ pari dyāvāpṛthivī yāti sadyaḥ || [3.058.08c]

aśvinā madhuṣuttamo yuvākuḥ somas tam pātam ā gataṁ duroṇe | [3.058.09a]
ratho ha vām bhūri varpaḥ karikrat sutāvato niṣkṛtam āgamiṣṭhaḥ || [3.058.09c]

mitro janān yātayati bruvāṇo mitro dādhāra pṛthivīm uta dyām | [3.059.01a]
mitraḥ kṛṣṭīr animiṣābhi caṣṭe mitrāya havyaṁ ghṛtavaj juhota || [3.059.01c]

pra sa mitra marto astu prayasvān yas ta āditya śikṣati vratena | [3.059.02a]
na hanyate na jīyate tvoto nainam aṁho aśnoty antito na dūrāt || [3.059.02c]

anamīvāsa iḻayā madanto mitajñavo varimann ā pṛthivyāḥ | [3.059.03a]
ādityasya vratam upakṣiyanto vayam mitrasya sumatau syāma || [3.059.03c]

ayam mitro namasyaḥ suśevo rājā sukṣatro ajaniṣṭa vedhāḥ | [3.059.04a]
tasya vayaṁ sumatau yajñiyasyāpi bhadre saumanase syāma || [3.059.04c]

mahām̐ ādityo namasopasadyo yātayajjano gṛṇate suśevaḥ | [3.059.05a]
tasmā etat panyatamāya juṣṭam agnau mitrāya havir ā juhota || [3.059.05c]

mitrasya carṣaṇīdhṛto 'vo devasya sānasi | [3.059.06a]
dyumnaṁ citraśravastamam || [3.059.06c]

abhi yo mahinā divam mitro babhūva saprathāḥ | [3.059.07a]
abhi śravobhiḥ pṛthivīm || [3.059.07c]

mitrāya pañca yemire janā abhiṣṭiśavase | [3.059.08a]
sa devān viśvān bibharti || [3.059.08c]

mitro deveṣv āyuṣu janāya vṛktabarhiṣe | [3.059.09a]
iṣa iṣṭavratā akaḥ || [3.059.09c]

iheha vo manasā bandhutā nara uśijo jagmur abhi tāni vedasā | [3.060.01a]
yābhir māyābhiḥ pratijūtivarpasaḥ saudhanvanā yajñiyam bhāgam ānaśa || [3.060.01c]

yābhiḥ śacībhiś camasām̐ apiṁśata yayā dhiyā gām ariṇīta carmaṇaḥ | [3.060.02a]
yena harī manasā niratakṣata tena devatvam ṛbhavaḥ sam ānaśa || [3.060.02c]

indrasya sakhyam ṛbhavaḥ sam ānaśur manor napāto apaso dadhanvire | [3.060.03a]
saudhanvanāso amṛtatvam erire viṣṭvī śamībhiḥ sukṛtaḥ sukṛtyayā || [3.060.03c]

indreṇa yātha sarathaṁ sute sacām̐ atho vaśānām bhavathā saha śriyā | [3.060.04a]
na vaḥ pratimai sukṛtāni vāghataḥ saudhanvanā ṛbhavo vīryāṇi ca || [3.060.04c]

indra ṛbhubhir vājavadbhiḥ samukṣitaṁ sutaṁ somam ā vṛṣasvā gabhastyoḥ | [3.060.05a]
dhiyeṣito maghavan dāśuṣo gṛhe saudhanvanebhiḥ saha matsvā nṛbhiḥ || [3.060.05c]

indra ṛbhumān vājavān matsveha no 'smin savane śacyā puruṣṭuta | [3.060.06a]
imāni tubhyaṁ svasarāṇi yemire vratā devānām manuṣaś ca dharmabhiḥ || [3.060.06c]

indra ṛbhubhir vājibhir vājayann iha stomaṁ jaritur upa yāhi yajñiyam | [3.060.07a]
śataṁ ketebhir iṣirebhir āyave sahasraṇītho adhvarasya homani || [3.060.07c]

uṣo vājena vājini pracetāḥ stomaṁ juṣasva gṛṇato maghoni | [3.061.01a]
purāṇī devi yuvatiḥ puraṁdhir anu vrataṁ carasi viśvavāre || [3.061.01c]

uṣo devy amartyā vi bhāhi candrarathā sūnṛtā īrayantī | [3.061.02a]
ā tvā vahantu suyamāso aśvā hiraṇyavarṇām pṛthupājaso ye || [3.061.02c]

uṣaḥ pratīcī bhuvanāni viśvordhvā tiṣṭhasy amṛtasya ketuḥ | [3.061.03a]
samānam arthaṁ caraṇīyamānā cakram iva navyasy ā vavṛtsva || [3.061.03c]

ava syūmeva cinvatī maghony uṣā yāti svasarasya patnī | [3.061.04a]
sva1r janantī subhagā sudaṁsā āntād divaḥ papratha ā pṛthivyāḥ || [3.061.04c]

acchā vo devīm uṣasaṁ vibhātīm pra vo bharadhvaṁ namasā suvṛktim | [3.061.05a]
ūrdhvam madhudhā divi pājo aśret pra rocanā ruruce raṇvasaṁdṛk || [3.061.05c]

ṛtāvarī divo arkair abodhy ā revatī rodasī citram asthāt | [3.061.06a]
āyatīm agna uṣasaṁ vibhātīṁ vāmam eṣi draviṇam bhikṣamāṇaḥ || [3.061.06c]

ṛtasya budhna uṣasām iṣaṇyan vṛṣā mahī rodasī ā viveśa | [3.061.07a]
mahī mitrasya varuṇasya māyā candreva bhānuṁ vi dadhe purutrā || [3.061.07c]

imā u vām bhṛmayo manyamānā yuvāvate na tujyā abhūvan | [3.062.01a]
kva1 tyad indrāvaruṇā yaśo vāṁ yena smā sinam bharathaḥ sakhibhyaḥ || [3.062.01c]

ayam u vām purutamo rayīyañ chaśvattamam avase johavīti | [3.062.02a]
sajoṣāv indrāvaruṇā marudbhir divā pṛthivyā śṛṇutaṁ havam me || [3.062.02c]

asme tad indrāvaruṇā vasu ṣyād asme rayir marutaḥ sarvavīraḥ | [3.062.03a]
asmān varūtrīḥ śaraṇair avantv asmān hotrā bhāratī dakṣiṇābhiḥ || [3.062.03c]

bṛhaspate juṣasva no havyāni viśvadevya | [3.062.04a]
rāsva ratnāni dāśuṣe || [3.062.04c]

śucim arkair bṛhaspatim adhvareṣu namasyata | [3.062.05a]
anāmy oja ā cake || [3.062.05c]

vṛṣabhaṁ carṣaṇīnāṁ viśvarūpam adābhyam | [3.062.06a]
bṛhaspatiṁ vareṇyam || [3.062.06c]

iyaṁ te pūṣann āghṛṇe suṣṭutir deva navyasī | [3.062.07a]
asmābhis tubhyaṁ śasyate || [3.062.07c]

tāṁ juṣasva giram mama vājayantīm avā dhiyam | [3.062.08a]
vadhūyur iva yoṣaṇām || [3.062.08c]

yo viśvābhi vipaśyati bhuvanā saṁ ca paśyati | [3.062.09a]
sa naḥ pūṣāvitā bhuvat || [3.062.09c]

tat savitur vareṇyam bhargo devasya dhīmahi | [3.062.10a]
dhiyo yo naḥ pracodayāt || [3.062.10c]

devasya savitur vayaṁ vājayantaḥ puraṁdhyā | [3.062.11a]
bhagasya rātim īmahe || [3.062.11c]

devaṁ naraḥ savitāraṁ viprā yajñaiḥ suvṛktibhiḥ | [3.062.12a]
namasyanti dhiyeṣitāḥ || [3.062.12c]

somo jigāti gātuvid devānām eti niṣkṛtam | [3.062.13a]
ṛtasya yonim āsadam || [3.062.13c]

somo asmabhyaṁ dvipade catuṣpade ca paśave | [3.062.14a]
anamīvā iṣas karat || [3.062.14c]

asmākam āyur vardhayann abhimātīḥ sahamānaḥ | [3.062.15a]
somaḥ sadhastham āsadat || [3.062.15c]

ā no mitrāvaruṇā ghṛtair gavyūtim ukṣatam | [3.062.16a]
madhvā rajāṁsi sukratū || [3.062.16c]

uruśaṁsā namovṛdhā mahnā dakṣasya rājathaḥ | [3.062.17a]
drāghiṣṭhābhiḥ śucivratā || [3.062.17c]

gṛṇānā jamadagninā yonāv ṛtasya sīdatam | [3.062.18a]
pātaṁ somam ṛtāvṛdhā || [3.062.18c]

Maṇḍala 4

tvāṁ hy agne sadam it samanyavo devāso devam aratiṁ nyerira iti kratvā nyerire | [4.001.01a]
amartyaṁ yajata martyeṣv ā devam ādevaṁ janata pracetasaṁ viśvam ādevaṁ janata pracetasam || [4.001.01c]

sa bhrātaraṁ varuṇam agna ā vavṛtsva devām̐ acchā sumatī yajñavanasaṁ jyeṣṭhaṁ yajñavanasam | [4.001.02a]
ṛtāvānam ādityaṁ carṣaṇīdhṛtaṁ rājānaṁ carṣaṇīdhṛtam || [4.001.02c]

sakhe sakhāyam abhy ā vavṛtsvāśuṁ na cakraṁ rathyeva raṁhyāsmabhyaṁ dasma raṁhyā | [4.001.03a]
agne mṛḻīkaṁ varuṇe sacā vido marutsu viśvabhānuṣu | [4.001.03c]
tokāya tuje śuśucāna śaṁ kṛdhy asmabhyaṁ dasma śaṁ kṛdhi || [4.001.03d]

tvaṁ no agne varuṇasya vidvān devasya heḻo 'va yāsisīṣṭhāḥ | [4.001.04a]
yajiṣṭho vahnitamaḥ śośucāno viśvā dveṣāṁsi pra mumugdhy asmat || [4.001.04c]

sa tvaṁ no agne 'vamo bhavotī nediṣṭho asyā uṣaso vyuṣṭau | [4.001.05a]
ava yakṣva no varuṇaṁ rarāṇo vīhi mṛḻīkaṁ suhavo na edhi || [4.001.05c]

asya śreṣṭhā subhagasya saṁdṛg devasya citratamā martyeṣu | [4.001.06a]
śuci ghṛtaṁ na taptam aghnyāyāḥ spārhā devasya maṁhaneva dhenoḥ || [4.001.06c]

trir asya tā paramā santi satyā spārhā devasya janimāny agneḥ | [4.001.07a]
anante antaḥ parivīta āgāc chuciḥ śukro aryo rorucānaḥ || [4.001.07c]

sa dūto viśved abhi vaṣṭi sadmā hotā hiraṇyaratho raṁsujihvaḥ | [4.001.08a]
rohidaśvo vapuṣyo vibhāvā sadā raṇvaḥ pitumatīva saṁsat || [4.001.08c]

sa cetayan manuṣo yajñabandhuḥ pra tam mahyā raśanayā nayanti | [4.001.09a]
sa kṣety asya duryāsu sādhan devo martasya sadhanitvam āpa || [4.001.09c]

sa tū no agnir nayatu prajānann acchā ratnaṁ devabhaktaṁ yad asya | [4.001.10a]
dhiyā yad viśve amṛtā akṛṇvan dyauṣ pitā janitā satyam ukṣan || [4.001.10c]

sa jāyata prathamaḥ pastyāsu maho budhne rajaso asya yonau | [4.001.11a]
apād aśīrṣā guhamāno antāyoyuvāno vṛṣabhasya nīḻe || [4.001.11b]

pra śardha ārta prathamaṁ vipanyām̐ ṛtasya yonā vṛṣabhasya nīḻe | [4.001.12a]
spārho yuvā vapuṣyo vibhāvā sapta priyāso 'janayanta vṛṣṇe || [4.001.12c]

asmākam atra pitaro manuṣyā abhi pra sedur ṛtam āśuṣāṇāḥ | [4.001.13a]
aśmavrajāḥ sudughā vavre antar ud usrā ājann uṣaso huvānāḥ || [4.001.13c]

te marmṛjata dadṛvāṁso adriṁ tad eṣām anye abhito vi vocan | [4.001.14a]
paśvayantrāso abhi kāram arcan vidanta jyotiś cakṛpanta dhībhiḥ || [4.001.14c]

te gavyatā manasā dṛdhram ubdhaṁ gā yemānam pari ṣantam adrim | [4.001.15a]
dṛḻhaṁ naro vacasā daivyena vrajaṁ gomantam uśijo vi vavruḥ || [4.001.15c]

te manvata prathamaṁ nāma dhenos triḥ sapta mātuḥ paramāṇi vindan | [4.001.16a]
taj jānatīr abhy anūṣata vrā āvir bhuvad aruṇīr yaśasā goḥ || [4.001.16c]

neśat tamo dudhitaṁ rocata dyaur ud devyā uṣaso bhānur arta | [4.001.17a]
ā sūryo bṛhatas tiṣṭhad ajrām̐ ṛju marteṣu vṛjinā ca paśyan || [4.001.17c]

ād it paścā bubudhānā vy akhyann ād id ratnaṁ dhārayanta dyubhaktam | [4.001.18a]
viśve viśvāsu duryāsu devā mitra dhiye varuṇa satyam astu || [4.001.18c]

acchā voceya śuśucānam agniṁ hotāraṁ viśvabharasaṁ yajiṣṭham | [4.001.19a]
śucy ūdho atṛṇan na gavām andho na pūtam pariṣiktam aṁśoḥ || [4.001.19c]

viśveṣām aditir yajñiyānāṁ viśveṣām atithir mānuṣāṇām | [4.001.20a]
agnir devānām ava āvṛṇānaḥ sumṛḻīko bhavatu jātavedāḥ || [4.001.20c]

yo martyeṣv amṛta ṛtāvā devo deveṣv aratir nidhāyi | [4.002.01a]
hotā yajiṣṭho mahnā śucadhyai havyair agnir manuṣa īrayadhyai || [4.002.01c]

iha tvaṁ sūno sahaso no adya jāto jātām̐ ubhayām̐ antar agne | [4.002.02a]
dūta īyase yuyujāna ṛṣva ṛjumuṣkān vṛṣaṇaḥ śukrām̐ś ca || [4.002.02c]

atyā vṛdhasnū rohitā ghṛtasnū ṛtasya manye manasā javiṣṭhā | [4.002.03a]
antar īyase aruṣā yujāno yuṣmām̐ś ca devān viśa ā ca martān || [4.002.03c]

aryamaṇaṁ varuṇam mitram eṣām indrāviṣṇū maruto aśvinota | [4.002.04a]
svaśvo agne surathaḥ surādhā ed u vaha suhaviṣe janāya || [4.002.04c]

gomām̐ agne 'vimām̐ aśvī yajño nṛvatsakhā sadam id apramṛṣyaḥ | [4.002.05a]
iḻāvām̐ eṣo asura prajāvān dīrgho rayiḥ pṛthubudhnaḥ sabhāvān || [4.002.05c]

yas ta idhmaṁ jabharat siṣvidāno mūrdhānaṁ vā tatapate tvāyā | [4.002.06a]
bhuvas tasya svatavām̐ḥ pāyur agne viśvasmāt sīm aghāyata uruṣya || [4.002.06c]

yas te bharād anniyate cid annaṁ niśiṣan mandram atithim udīrat | [4.002.07a]
ā devayur inadhate duroṇe tasmin rayir dhruvo astu dāsvān || [4.002.07c]

yas tvā doṣā ya uṣasi praśaṁsāt priyaṁ vā tvā kṛṇavate haviṣmān | [4.002.08a]
aśvo na sve dama ā hemyāvān tam aṁhasaḥ pīparo dāśvāṁsam || [4.002.08c]

yas tubhyam agne amṛtāya dāśad duvas tve kṛṇavate yatasruk | [4.002.09a]
na sa rāyā śaśamāno vi yoṣan nainam aṁhaḥ pari varad aghāyoḥ || [4.002.09c]

yasya tvam agne adhvaraṁ jujoṣo devo martasya sudhitaṁ rarāṇaḥ | [4.002.10a]
prīted asad dhotrā sā yaviṣṭhāsāma yasya vidhato vṛdhāsaḥ || [4.002.10c]

cittim acittiṁ cinavad vi vidvān pṛṣṭheva vītā vṛjinā ca martān | [4.002.11a]
rāye ca naḥ svapatyāya deva ditiṁ ca rāsvāditim uruṣya || [4.002.11c]

kaviṁ śaśāsuḥ kavayo 'dabdhā nidhārayanto duryāsv āyoḥ | [4.002.12a]
atas tvaṁ dṛśyām̐ agna etān paḍbhiḥ paśyer adbhutām̐ arya evaiḥ || [4.002.12c]

tvam agne vāghate supraṇītiḥ sutasomāya vidhate yaviṣṭha | [4.002.13a]
ratnam bhara śaśamānāya ghṛṣve pṛthu ścandram avase carṣaṇiprāḥ || [4.002.13c]

idam u tyat purutamam purastāj jyotis tamaso vayunāvad asthāt | [4.051.01a]

tā in nv e3va samanā samānīr amītavarṇā uṣasaś caranti | [4.051.09a]

prati ṣyā sūnarī janī vyucchantī pari svasuḥ | [4.052.01a]

āprā rajāṁsi divyāni pārthivā ślokaṁ devaḥ kṛṇute svāya dharmaṇe | [4.053.03a]

trir antarikṣaṁ savitā mahitvanā trī rajāṁsi paribhus trīṇi rocanā | [4.053.05a]

bṛhatsumnaḥ prasavītā niveśano jagataḥ sthātur ubhayasya yo vaśī | [4.053.06a]

abhūd devaḥ savitā vandyo nu na idānīm ahna upavācyo nṛbhiḥ | [4.054.01a]

na pramiye savitur daivyasya tad yathā viśvam bhuvanaṁ dhārayiṣyati | [4.054.04a]

pra ye dhāmāni pūrvyāṇy arcān vi yad ucchān viyotāro amūrāḥ | [4.055.02a]

pra pastyā3m aditiṁ sindhum arkaiḥ svastim īḻe sakhyāya devīm | [4.055.03a]

ā parvatasya marutām avāṁsi devasya trātur avri bhagasya | [4.055.05a]

Maṇḍala 5

abodhy agniḥ samidhā janānām prati dhenum ivāyatīm uṣāsam | [5.001.01a]

kumāram mātā yuvatiḥ samubdhaṁ guhā bibharti na dadāti pitre | [5.002.01a]

tvam agne varuṇo jāyase yat tvam mitro bhavasi yat samiddhaḥ | [5.003.01a]

viśveṣāṁ vaḥ satāṁ jyeṣṭhatamā gīrbhir mitrāvaruṇā vāvṛdhadhyai | [6.067.01a]
saṁ yā raśmeva yamatur yamiṣṭhā dvā janām̐ asamā bāhubhiḥ svaiḥ || [6.067.01c]

iyam mad vām pra stṛṇīte manīṣopa priyā namasā barhir accha | [6.067.02a]
yantaṁ no mitrāvaruṇāv adhṛṣṭaṁ chardir yad vāṁ varūthyaṁ sudānū || [6.067.02c]

ā yātam mitrāvaruṇā suśasty upa priyā namasā hūyamānā | [6.067.03a]
saṁ yāv apnaḥstho apaseva janāñ chrudhīyataś cid yatatho mahitvā || [6.067.03c]

aśvā na yā vājinā pūtabandhū ṛtā yad garbham aditir bharadhyai | [6.067.04a]
pra yā mahi mahāntā jāyamānā ghorā martāya ripave ni dīdhaḥ || [6.067.04c]

viśve yad vām maṁhanā mandamānāḥ kṣatraṁ devāso adadhuḥ sajoṣāḥ | [6.067.05a]
pari yad bhūtho rodasī cid urvī santi spaśo adabdhāso amūrāḥ || [6.067.05c]

tā hi kṣatraṁ dhārayethe anu dyūn dṛṁhethe sānum upamād iva dyoḥ | [6.067.06a]
dṛḻho nakṣatra uta viśvadevo bhūmim ātān dyāṁ dhāsināyoḥ || [6.067.06c]

tā vigraṁ dhaithe jaṭharam pṛṇadhyā ā yat sadma sabhṛtayaḥ pṛṇanti | [6.067.07a]
na mṛṣyante yuvatayo 'vātā vi yat payo viśvajinvā bharante || [6.067.07c]

tā jihvayā sadam edaṁ sumedhā ā yad vāṁ satyo aratir ṛte bhūt | [6.067.08a]
tad vām mahitvaṁ ghṛtānnāv astu yuvaṁ dāśuṣe vi cayiṣṭam aṁhaḥ || [6.067.08c]

pra yad vām mitrāvaruṇā spūrdhan priyā dhāma yuvadhitā minanti | [6.067.09a]
na ye devāsa ohasā na martā ayajñasāco apyo na putrāḥ || [6.067.09c]

vi yad vācaṁ kīstāso bharante śaṁsanti ke cin nivido manānāḥ | [6.067.10a]
ād vām bravāma satyāny ukthā nakir devebhir yatatho mahitvā || [6.067.10c]

avor itthā vāṁ chardiṣo abhiṣṭau yuvor mitrāvaruṇāv askṛdhoyu | [6.067.11a]
anu yad gāvaḥ sphurān ṛjipyaṁ dhṛṣṇuṁ yad raṇe vṛṣaṇaṁ yunajan || [6.067.11c]

śruṣṭī vāṁ yajña udyataḥ sajoṣā manuṣvad vṛktabarhiṣo yajadhyai | [6.068.01a]
ā ya indrāvaruṇāv iṣe adya mahe sumnāya maha āvavartat || [6.068.01c]

tā hi śreṣṭhā devatātā tujā śūrāṇāṁ śaviṣṭhā tā hi bhūtam | [6.068.02a]
maghonām maṁhiṣṭhā tuviśuṣma ṛtena vṛtraturā sarvasenā || [6.068.02c]

tā gṛṇīhi namasyebhiḥ śūṣaiḥ sumnebhir indrāvaruṇā cakānā | [6.068.03a]
vajreṇānyaḥ śavasā hanti vṛtraṁ siṣakty anyo vṛjaneṣu vipraḥ || [6.068.03c]

gnāś ca yan naraś ca vāvṛdhanta viśve devāso narāṁ svagūrtāḥ | [6.068.04a]
praibhya indrāvaruṇā mahitvā dyauś ca pṛthivi bhūtam urvī || [6.068.04c]

sa it sudānuḥ svavām̐ ṛtāvendrā yo vāṁ varuṇa dāśati tman | [6.068.05a]
iṣā sa dviṣas tared dāsvān vaṁsad rayiṁ rayivataś ca janān || [6.068.05c]

yaṁ yuvaṁ dāśvadhvarāya devā rayiṁ dhattho vasumantam purukṣum | [6.068.06a]
asme sa indrāvaruṇāv api ṣyāt pra yo bhanakti vanuṣām aśastīḥ || [6.068.06c]

uta naḥ sutrātro devagopāḥ sūribhya indrāvaruṇā rayiḥ ṣyāt | [6.068.07a]
yeṣāṁ śuṣmaḥ pṛtanāsu sāhvān pra sadyo dyumnā tirate taturiḥ || [6.068.07c]

nū na indrāvaruṇā gṛṇānā pṛṅktaṁ rayiṁ sauśravasāya devā | [6.068.08a]
itthā gṛṇanto mahinasya śardho 'po na nāvā duritā tarema || [6.068.08c]

pra samrāje bṛhate manma nu priyam arca devāya varuṇāya saprathaḥ | [6.068.09a]
ayaṁ ya urvī mahinā mahivrataḥ kratvā vibhāty ajaro na śociṣā || [6.068.09c]

indrāvaruṇā sutapāv imaṁ sutaṁ somam pibatam madyaṁ dhṛtavratā | [6.068.10a]
yuvo ratho adhvaraṁ devavītaye prati svasaram upa yāti pītaye || [6.068.10c]

indrāvaruṇā madhumattamasya vṛṣṇaḥ somasya vṛṣaṇā vṛṣethām | [6.068.11a]
idaṁ vām andhaḥ pariṣiktam asme āsadyāsmin barhiṣi mādayethām || [6.068.11c]

saṁ vāṁ karmaṇā sam iṣā hinomīndrāviṣṇū apasas pāre asya | [6.069.01a]
juṣethāṁ yajñaṁ draviṇaṁ ca dhattam ariṣṭair naḥ pathibhiḥ pārayantā || [6.069.01c]

yā viśvāsāṁ janitārā matīnām indrāviṣṇū kalaśā somadhānā | [6.069.02a]
pra vāṁ giraḥ śasyamānā avantu pra stomāso gīyamānāso arkaiḥ || [6.069.02c]

indrāviṣṇū madapatī madānām ā somaṁ yātaṁ draviṇo dadhānā | [6.069.03a]
saṁ vām añjantv aktubhir matīnāṁ saṁ stomāsaḥ śasyamānāsa ukthaiḥ || [6.069.03c]

ā vām aśvāso abhimātiṣāha indrāviṣṇū sadhamādo vahantu | [6.069.04a]
juṣethāṁ viśvā havanā matīnām upa brahmāṇi śṛṇutaṁ giro me || [6.069.04c]

indrāviṣṇū tat panayāyyaṁ vāṁ somasya mada uru cakramāthe | [6.069.05a]
akṛṇutam antarikṣaṁ varīyo 'prathataṁ jīvase no rajāṁsi || [6.069.05c]

indrāviṣṇū haviṣā vāvṛdhānāgrādvānā namasā rātahavyā | [6.069.06a]
ghṛtāsutī draviṇaṁ dhattam asme samudraḥ sthaḥ kalaśaḥ somadhānaḥ || [6.069.06c]

indrāviṣṇū pibatam madhvo asya somasya dasrā jaṭharam pṛṇethām | [6.069.07a]
ā vām andhāṁsi madirāṇy agmann upa brahmāṇi śṛṇutaṁ havam me || [6.069.07c]

ubhā jigyathur na parā jayethe na parā jigye kataraś canainoḥ | [6.069.08a]
indraś ca viṣṇo yad apaspṛdhethāṁ tredhā sahasraṁ vi tad airayethām || [6.069.08c]

ghṛtavatī bhuvanānām abhiśriyorvī pṛthvī madhudughe supeśasā | [6.070.01a]
dyāvāpṛthivī varuṇasya dharmaṇā viṣkabhite ajare bhūriretasā || [6.070.01c]

asaścantī bhūridhāre payasvatī ghṛtaṁ duhāte sukṛte śucivrate | [6.070.02a]
rājantī asya bhuvanasya rodasī asme retaḥ siñcataṁ yan manurhitam || [6.070.02c]

yo vām ṛjave kramaṇāya rodasī marto dadāśa dhiṣaṇe sa sādhati | [6.070.03a]
pra prajābhir jāyate dharmaṇas pari yuvoḥ siktā viṣurūpāṇi savratā || [6.070.03c]

ghṛtena dyāvāpṛthivī abhīvṛte ghṛtaśriyā ghṛtapṛcā ghṛtāvṛdhā | [6.070.04a]
urvī pṛthvī hotṛvūrye purohite te id viprā īḻate sumnam iṣṭaye || [6.070.04c]

madhu no dyāvāpṛthivī mimikṣatām madhuścutā madhudughe madhuvrate | [6.070.05a]
dadhāne yajñaṁ draviṇaṁ ca devatā mahi śravo vājam asme suvīryam || [6.070.05c]

ūrjaṁ no dyauś ca pṛthivī ca pinvatām pitā mātā viśvavidā sudaṁsasā | [6.070.06a]
saṁrarāṇe rodasī viśvaśambhuvā saniṁ vājaṁ rayim asme sam invatām || [6.070.06c]

ud u ṣya devaḥ savitā hiraṇyayā bāhū ayaṁsta savanāya sukratuḥ | [6.071.01a]
ghṛtena pāṇī abhi pruṣṇute makho yuvā sudakṣo rajaso vidharmaṇi || [6.071.01c]

devasya vayaṁ savituḥ savīmani śreṣṭhe syāma vasunaś ca dāvane | [6.071.02a]
yo viśvasya dvipado yaś catuṣpado niveśane prasave cāsi bhūmanaḥ || [6.071.02c]

adabdhebhiḥ savitaḥ pāyubhiṣ ṭvaṁ śivebhir adya pari pāhi no gayam | [6.071.03a]
hiraṇyajihvaḥ suvitāya navyase rakṣā mākir no aghaśaṁsa īśata || [6.071.03c]

ud u ṣya devaḥ savitā damūnā hiraṇyapāṇiḥ pratidoṣam asthāt | [6.071.04a]
ayohanur yajato mandrajihva ā dāśuṣe suvati bhūri vāmam || [6.071.04c]

ud ū ayām̐ upavakteva bāhū hiraṇyayā savitā supratīkā | [6.071.05a]
divo rohāṁsy aruhat pṛthivyā arīramat patayat kac cid abhvam || [6.071.05c]

vāmam adya savitar vāmam u śvo dive-dive vāmam asmabhyaṁ sāvīḥ | [6.071.06a]
vāmasya hi kṣayasya deva bhūrer ayā dhiyā vāmabhājaḥ syāma || [6.071.06c]

indrāsomā mahi tad vām mahitvaṁ yuvam mahāni prathamāni cakrathuḥ | [6.072.01a]
yuvaṁ sūryaṁ vividathur yuvaṁ sva1r viśvā tamāṁsy ahataṁ nidaś ca || [6.072.01c]

indrāsomā vāsayatha uṣāsam ut sūryaṁ nayatho jyotiṣā saha | [6.072.02a]
upa dyāṁ skambhathuḥ skambhanenāprathatam pṛthivīm mātaraṁ vi || [6.072.02c]

indrāsomāv ahim apaḥ pariṣṭhāṁ hatho vṛtram anu vāṁ dyaur amanyata | [6.072.03a]
prārṇāṁsy airayataṁ nadīnām ā samudrāṇi paprathuḥ purūṇi || [6.072.03c]

indrāsomā pakvam āmāsv antar ni gavām id dadhathur vakṣaṇāsu | [6.072.04a]
jagṛbhathur anapinaddham āsu ruśac citrāsu jagatīṣv antaḥ || [6.072.04c]

indrāsomā yuvam aṅga tarutram apatyasācaṁ śrutyaṁ rarāthe | [6.072.05a]
yuvaṁ śuṣmaṁ naryaṁ carṣaṇibhyaḥ saṁ vivyathuḥ pṛtanāṣāham ugrā || [6.072.05c]

yo adribhit prathamajā ṛtāvā bṛhaspatir āṅgiraso haviṣmān | [6.073.01a]
dvibarhajmā prāgharmasat pitā na ā rodasī vṛṣabho roravīti || [6.073.01c]

janāya cid ya īvata u lokam bṛhaspatir devahūtau cakāra | [6.073.02a]
ghnan vṛtrāṇi vi puro dardarīti jayañ chatrūm̐r amitrān pṛtsu sāhan || [6.073.02c]

bṛhaspatiḥ sam ajayad vasūni maho vrajān gomato deva eṣaḥ | [6.073.03a]
apaḥ siṣāsan sva1r apratīto bṛhaspatir hanty amitram arkaiḥ || [6.073.03c]

somārudrā dhārayethām asurya1m pra vām iṣṭayo 'ram aśnuvantu | [6.074.01a]
dame-dame sapta ratnā dadhānā śaṁ no bhūtaṁ dvipade śaṁ catuṣpade || [6.074.01c]

somārudrā vi vṛhataṁ viṣūcīm amīvā yā no gayam āviveśa | [6.074.02a]
āre bādhethāṁ nirṛtim parācair asme bhadrā sauśravasāni santu || [6.074.02c]

somārudrā yuvam etāny asme viśvā tanūṣu bheṣajāni dhattam | [6.074.03a]
ava syatam muñcataṁ yan no asti tanūṣu baddhaṁ kṛtam eno asmat || [6.074.03c]

tigmāyudhau tigmahetī suśevau somārudrāv iha su mṛḻataṁ naḥ | [6.074.04a]
pra no muñcataṁ varuṇasya pāśād gopāyataṁ naḥ sumanasyamānā || [6.074.04c]

jīmūtasyeva bhavati pratīkaṁ yad varmī yāti samadām upasthe | [6.075.01a]
anāviddhayā tanvā jaya tvaṁ sa tvā varmaṇo mahimā pipartu || [6.075.01c]

dhanvanā gā dhanvanājiṁ jayema dhanvanā tīvrāḥ samado jayema | [6.075.02a]
dhanuḥ śatror apakāmaṁ kṛṇoti dhanvanā sarvāḥ pradiśo jayema || [6.075.02c]

vakṣyantīved ā ganīganti karṇam priyaṁ sakhāyam pariṣasvajānā | [6.075.03a]
yoṣeva śiṅkte vitatādhi dhanvañ jyā iyaṁ samane pārayantī || [6.075.03c]

te ācarantī samaneva yoṣā māteva putram bibhṛtām upasthe | [6.075.04a]
apa śatrūn vidhyatāṁ saṁvidāne ārtnī ime viṣphurantī amitrān || [6.075.04c]

bahvīnām pitā bahur asya putraś ciścā kṛṇoti samanāvagatya | [6.075.05a]
iṣudhiḥ saṅkāḥ pṛtanāś ca sarvāḥ pṛṣṭhe ninaddho jayati prasūtaḥ || [6.075.05c]

rathe tiṣṭhan nayati vājinaḥ puro yatra-yatra kāmayate suṣārathiḥ | [6.075.06a]
abhīśūnām mahimānam panāyata manaḥ paścād anu yacchanti raśmayaḥ || [6.075.06c]

tīvrān ghoṣān kṛṇvate vṛṣapāṇayo 'śvā rathebhiḥ saha vājayantaḥ | [6.075.07a]
avakrāmantaḥ prapadair amitrān kṣiṇanti śatrūm̐r anapavyayantaḥ || [6.075.07c]

rathavāhanaṁ havir asya nāma yatrāyudhaṁ nihitam asya varma | [6.075.08a]
tatrā ratham upa śagmaṁ sadema viśvāhā vayaṁ sumanasyamānāḥ || [6.075.08c]

svāduṣaṁsadaḥ pitaro vayodhāḥ kṛcchreśritaḥ śaktīvanto gabhīrāḥ | [6.075.09a]
citrasenā iṣubalā amṛdhrāḥ satovīrā uravo vrātasāhāḥ || [6.075.09c]

brāhmaṇāsaḥ pitaraḥ somyāsaḥ śive no dyāvāpṛthivī anehasā | [6.075.10a]
pūṣā naḥ pātu duritād ṛtāvṛdho rakṣā mākir no aghaśaṁsa īśata || [6.075.10c]

suparṇaṁ vaste mṛgo asyā danto gobhiḥ saṁnaddhā patati prasūtā | [6.075.11a]
yatrā naraḥ saṁ ca vi ca dravanti tatrāsmabhyam iṣavaḥ śarma yaṁsan || [6.075.11c]

ṛjīte pari vṛṅdhi no 'śmā bhavatu nas tanūḥ | [6.075.12a]
somo adhi bravītu no 'ditiḥ śarma yacchatu || [6.075.12c]

ā jaṅghanti sānv eṣāṁ jaghanām̐ upa jighnate | [6.075.13a]
aśvājani pracetaso 'śvān samatsu codaya || [6.075.13c]

ahir iva bhogaiḥ pary eti bāhuṁ jyāyā hetim paribādhamānaḥ | [6.075.14a]
hastaghno viśvā vayunāni vidvān pumān pumāṁsam pari pātu viśvataḥ || [6.075.14c]

ālāktā yā ruruśīrṣṇy atho yasyā ayo mukham | [6.075.15a]
idam parjanyaretasa iṣvai devyai bṛhan namaḥ || [6.075.15c]

avasṛṣṭā parā pata śaravye brahmasaṁśite | [6.075.16a]
gacchāmitrān pra padyasva māmīṣāṁ kaṁ canoc chiṣaḥ || [6.075.16c]

yatra bāṇāḥ sampatanti kumārā viśikhā iva | [6.075.17a]
tatrā no brahmaṇas patir aditiḥ śarma yacchatu viśvāhā śarma yacchatu || [6.075.17c]

marmāṇi te varmaṇā chādayāmi somas tvā rājāmṛtenānu vastām | [6.075.18a]
uror varīyo varuṇas te kṛṇotu jayantaṁ tvānu devā madantu || [6.075.18c]

yo naḥ svo araṇo yaś ca niṣṭyo jighāṁsati | [6.075.19a]
devās taṁ sarve dhūrvantu brahma varma mamāntaram || [6.075.19c]

Maṇḍala 7

agniṁ naro dīdhitibhir araṇyor hastacyutī janayanta praśastam | [7.001.01a]
dūredṛśaṁ gṛhapatim atharyum || [7.001.01c]

tam agnim aste vasavo ny ṛṇvan supraticakṣam avase kutaś cit | [7.001.02a]
dakṣāyyo yo dama āsa nityaḥ || [7.001.02c]

preddho agne dīdihi puro no 'jasrayā sūrmyā yaviṣṭha | [7.001.03a]
tvāṁ śaśvanta upa yanti vājāḥ || [7.001.03c]

pra te agnayo 'gnibhyo varaṁ niḥ suvīrāsaḥ śośucanta dyumantaḥ | [7.001.04a]
yatrā naraḥ samāsate sujātāḥ || [7.001.04c]

dā no agne dhiyā rayiṁ suvīraṁ svapatyaṁ sahasya praśastam | [7.001.05a]
na yaṁ yāvā tarati yātumāvān || [7.001.05c]

upa yam eti yuvatiḥ sudakṣaṁ doṣā vastor haviṣmatī ghṛtācī | [7.001.06a]
upa svainam aramatir vasūyuḥ || [7.001.06c]

viśvā agne 'pa dahārātīr yebhis tapobhir adaho jarūtham | [7.001.07a]
pra nisvaraṁ cātayasvāmīvām || [7.001.07c]

ā yas te agna idhate anīkaṁ vasiṣṭha śukra dīdivaḥ pāvaka | [7.001.08a]
uto na ebhiḥ stavathair iha syāḥ || [7.001.08c]

vi ye te agne bhejire anīkam martā naraḥ pitryāsaḥ purutrā | [7.001.09a]
uto na ebhiḥ sumanā iha syāḥ || [7.001.09c]

ime naro vṛtrahatyeṣu śūrā viśvā adevīr abhi santu māyāḥ | [7.001.10a]
ye me dhiyam panayanta praśastām || [7.001.10c]

mā śūne agne ni ṣadāma nṛṇām māśeṣaso 'vīratā pari tvā | [7.001.11a]
prajāvatīṣu duryāsu durya || [7.001.11c]

yam aśvī nityam upayāti yajñam prajāvantaṁ svapatyaṁ kṣayaṁ naḥ | [7.001.12a]
svajanmanā śeṣasā vāvṛdhānam || [7.001.12c]

pāhi no agne rakṣaso ajuṣṭāt pāhi dhūrter araruṣo aghāyoḥ | [7.001.13a]
tvā yujā pṛtanāyūm̐r abhi ṣyām || [7.001.13c]

sed agnir agnīm̐r aty astv anyān yatra vājī tanayo vīḻupāṇiḥ | [7.001.14a]
sahasrapāthā akṣarā sameti || [7.001.14c]

sed agnir yo vanuṣyato nipāti sameddhāram aṁhasa uruṣyāt | [7.001.15a]
sujātāsaḥ pari caranti vīrāḥ || [7.001.15c]

ayaṁ so agnir āhutaḥ purutrā yam īśānaḥ sam id indhe haviṣmān | [7.001.16a]
pari yam ety adhvareṣu hotā || [7.001.16c]

tve agna āhavanāni bhūrīśānāsa ā juhuyāma nityā | [7.001.17a]
ubhā kṛṇvanto vahatū miyedhe || [7.001.17c]

imo agne vītatamāni havyājasro vakṣi devatātim accha | [7.001.18a]
prati na īṁ surabhīṇi vyantu || [7.001.18c]

mā no agne 'vīrate parā dā durvāsase 'mataye mā no asyai | [7.001.19a]
mā naḥ kṣudhe mā rakṣasa ṛtāvo mā no dame mā vana ā juhūrthāḥ || [7.001.19c]

iyam manīṣā bṛhatī bṛhantorukramā tavasā vardhayantī | [7.099.06a]

vaṣaṭ te viṣṇav āsa ā kṛṇomi tan me juṣasva śipiviṣṭa havyam | [7.099.07a]
vardhantu tvā suṣṭutayo giro me yūyam pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ || [7.099.07c]

nū marto dayate saniṣyan yo viṣṇava urugāyāya dāśat | [7.100.01a]
pra yaḥ satrācā manasā yajāta etāvantaṁ naryam āvivāsāt || [7.100.01c]

tvaṁ viṣṇo sumatiṁ viśvajanyām aprayutām evayāvo matiṁ dāḥ | [7.100.02a]
parco yathā naḥ suvitasya bhūrer aśvāvataḥ puruścandrasya rāyaḥ || [7.100.02c]

trir devaḥ pṛthivīm eṣa etāṁ vi cakrame śatarcasam mahitvā | [7.100.03a]
pra viṣṇur astu tavasas tavīyān tveṣaṁ hy asya sthavirasya nāma || [7.100.03c]

vi cakrame pṛthivīm eṣa etāṁ kṣetrāya viṣṇur manuṣe daśasyan | [7.100.04a]

pra tat te adya śipiviṣṭa nāmāryaḥ śaṁsāmi vayunāni vidvān | [7.100.05a]

kim it te viṣṇo paricakṣyam bhūt pra yad vavakṣe śipiviṣṭo asmi | [7.100.06a]
mā varpo asmad apa gūha etad yad anyarūpaḥ samithe babhūtha || [7.100.06c]

vaṣaṭ te viṣṇav āsa ā kṛṇomi tan me juṣasva śipiviṣṭa havyam | [7.100.07a]
vardhantu tvā suṣṭutayo giro me yūyam pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ || [7.100.07c]

tisro vācaḥ pra vada jyotiragrā yā etad duhre madhudogham ūdhaḥ | [7.101.01a]
sa vatsaṁ kṛṇvan garbham oṣadhīnāṁ sadyo jāto vṛṣabho roravīti || [7.101.01c]

yo vardhana oṣadhīnāṁ yo apāṁ yo viśvasya jagato deva īśe | [7.101.02a]
sa tridhātu śaraṇaṁ śarma yaṁsat trivartu jyotiḥ svabhiṣṭy a1sme || [7.101.02c]

starīr u tvad bhavati sūta u tvad yathāvaśaṁ tanvaṁ cakra eṣaḥ | [7.101.03a]
pituḥ payaḥ prati gṛbhṇāti mātā tena pitā vardhate tena putraḥ || [7.101.03c]

yasmin viśvāni bhuvanāni tasthus tisro dyāvas tredhā sasrur āpaḥ | [7.101.04a]
trayaḥ kośāsa upasecanāso madhvaḥ ścotanty abhito virapśam || [7.101.04c]

idaṁ vacaḥ parjanyāya svarāje hṛdo astv antaraṁ taj jujoṣat | [7.101.05a]
mayobhuvo vṛṣṭayaḥ santv asme supippalā oṣadhīr devagopāḥ || [7.101.05c]

sa retodhā vṛṣabhaḥ śaśvatīnāṁ tasminn ātmā jagatas tasthuṣaś ca | [7.101.06a]
tan ma ṛtam pātu śataśāradāya yūyam pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ || [7.101.06c]

parjanyāya pra gāyata divas putrāya mīḻhuṣe | [7.102.01a]
sa no yavasam icchatu || [7.102.01c]

parjanyaḥ puruṣīṇām || [7.102.02c]

tasmā id āsye havir juhotā madhumattamam | [7.102.03a]
iḻāṁ naḥ saṁyataṁ karat || [7.102.03c]

saṁvatsaraṁ śaśayānā brāhmaṇā vratacāriṇaḥ | [7.103.01a]
vācam parjanyajinvitām pra maṇḍūkā avādiṣuḥ || [7.103.01c]

divyā āpo abhi yad enam āyan dṛtiṁ na śuṣkaṁ sarasī śayānam | [7.103.02a]
gavām aha na māyur vatsinīnām maṇḍūkānāṁ vagnur atrā sam eti || [7.103.02c]

yad īm enām̐ uśato abhy avarṣīt tṛṣyāvataḥ prāvṛṣy āgatāyām | [7.103.03a]
akhkhalīkṛtyā pitaraṁ na putro anyo anyam upa vadantam eti || [7.103.03c]

anyo anyam anu gṛbhṇāty enor apām prasarge yad amandiṣātām | [7.103.04a]
maṇḍūko yad abhivṛṣṭaḥ kaniṣkan pṛśniḥ sampṛṅkte haritena vācam || [7.103.04c]

yad eṣām anyo anyasya vācaṁ śāktasyeva vadati śikṣamāṇaḥ | [7.103.05a]
sarvaṁ tad eṣāṁ samṛdheva parva yat suvāco vadathanādhy apsu || [7.103.05c]

gomāyur eko ajamāyur ekaḥ pṛśnir eko harita eka eṣām | [7.103.06a]
samānaṁ nāma bibhrato virūpāḥ purutrā vācam pipiśur vadantaḥ || [7.103.06c]

brāhmaṇāso atirātre na some saro na pūrṇam abhito vadantaḥ | [7.103.07a]
saṁvatsarasya tad ahaḥ pari ṣṭha yan maṇḍūkāḥ prāvṛṣīṇam babhūva || [7.103.07c]

brāhmaṇāsaḥ somino vācam akrata brahma kṛṇvantaḥ parivatsarīṇam | [7.103.08a]
adhvaryavo gharmiṇaḥ siṣvidānā āvir bhavanti guhyā na ke cit || [7.103.08c]

devahitiṁ jugupur dvādaśasya ṛtuṁ naro na pra minanty ete | [7.103.09a]

gomāyur adād ajamāyur adāt pṛśnir adād dharito no vasūni | [7.103.10a]
gavām maṇḍūkā dadataḥ śatāni sahasrasāve pra tiranta āyuḥ || [7.103.10c]

indrāsomā tapataṁ rakṣa ubjataṁ ny arpayataṁ vṛṣaṇā tamovṛdhaḥ | [7.104.01a]

indrāsomā sam aghaśaṁsam abhy a1ghaṁ tapur yayastu carur agnivām̐ iva | [7.104.02a]
brahmadviṣe kravyāde ghoracakṣase dveṣo dhattam anavāyaṁ kimīdine || [7.104.02c]

indrāsomā duṣkṛto vavre antar anārambhaṇe tamasi pra vidhyatam | [7.104.03a]
yathā nātaḥ punar ekaś canodayat tad vām astu sahase manyumac chavaḥ || [7.104.03c]

indrāsomā vartayataṁ divo vadhaṁ sam pṛthivyā aghaśaṁsāya tarhaṇam | [7.104.04a]
ut takṣataṁ svarya1m parvatebhyo yena rakṣo vāvṛdhānaṁ nijūrvathaḥ || [7.104.04c]

indrāsomā vartayataṁ divas pary agnitaptebhir yuvam aśmahanmabhiḥ | [7.104.05a]
tapurvadhebhir ajarebhir atriṇo ni parśāne vidhyataṁ yantu nisvaram || [7.104.05c]

indrāsomā pari vām bhūtu viśvata iyam matiḥ kakṣyāśveva vājinā | [7.104.06a]

prati smarethāṁ tujayadbhir evair hataṁ druho rakṣaso bhaṅgurāvataḥ | [7.104.07a]

yo mā pākena manasā carantam abhicaṣṭe anṛtebhir vacobhiḥ | [7.104.08a]
āpa iva kāśinā saṁgṛbhītā asann astv āsata indra vaktā || [7.104.08c]

ye pākaśaṁsaṁ viharanta evair ye vā bhadraṁ dūṣayanti svadhābhiḥ | [7.104.09a]
ahaye vā tān pradadātu soma ā vā dadhātu nirṛter upasthe || [7.104.09c]

yo no rasaṁ dipsati pitvo agne yo aśvānāṁ yo gavāṁ yas tanūnām | [7.104.10a]
ripuḥ stenaḥ steyakṛd dabhram etu ni ṣa hīyatāṁ tanvā3 tanā ca || [7.104.10c]

paraḥ so astu tanvā3 tanā ca tisraḥ pṛthivīr adho astu viśvāḥ | [7.104.11a]

suvijñānaṁ cikituṣe janāya sac cāsac ca vacasī paspṛdhāte | [7.104.12a]

yadi vāham anṛtadeva āsa moghaṁ vā devām̐ apyūhe agne | [7.104.14a]

adyā murīya yadi yātudhāno asmi yadi vāyus tatapa pūruṣasya | [7.104.15a]

pra yā jigāti khargaleva naktam apa druhā tanva1ṁ gūhamānā | [7.104.17a]

pra vartaya divo aśmānam indra somaśitam maghavan saṁ śiśādhi | [7.104.19a]
prāktād apāktād adharād udaktād abhi jahi rakṣasaḥ parvatena || [7.104.19c]

eta u tye patayanti śvayātava indraṁ dipsanti dipsavo 'dābhyam | [7.104.20a]

indro yātūnām abhavat parāśaro havirmathīnām abhy ā3vivāsatām | [7.104.21a]

jyotir yacchanty ajasram || [10.185.03c]

vāta ā vātu bheṣajaṁ śambhu mayobhu no hṛde | [10.186.01a]
pra ṇa āyūṁṣi tāriṣat || [10.186.01c]

uta vāta pitāsi na uta bhrātota naḥ sakhā | [10.186.02a]
sa no jīvātave kṛdhi || [10.186.02c]

yad ado vāta te gṛhe3 'mṛtasya nidhir hitaḥ | [10.186.03a]
tato no dehi jīvase || [10.186.03c]

prāgnaye vācam īraya vṛṣabhāya kṣitīnām | [10.187.01a]
sa naḥ parṣad ati dviṣaḥ || [10.187.01c]

yaḥ parasyāḥ parāvatas tiro dhanvātirocate | [10.187.02a]
sa naḥ parṣad ati dviṣaḥ || [10.187.02c]

yo rakṣāṁsi nijūrvati vṛṣā śukreṇa śociṣā | [10.187.03a]
sa naḥ parṣad ati dviṣaḥ || [10.187.03c]

yo viśvābhi vipaśyati bhuvanā saṁ ca paśyati | [10.187.04a]
sa naḥ parṣad ati dviṣaḥ || [10.187.04c]

yo asya pāre rajasaḥ śukro agnir ajāyata | [10.187.05a]
sa naḥ parṣad ati dviṣaḥ || [10.187.05c]

pra nūnaṁ jātavedasam aśvaṁ hinota vājinam | [10.188.01a]
idaṁ no barhir āsade || [10.188.01c]

asya pra jātavedaso vipravīrasya mīḻhuṣaḥ | [10.188.02a]
mahīm iyarmi suṣṭutim || [10.188.02c]

yā ruco jātavedaso devatrā havyavāhanīḥ | [10.188.03a]
tābhir no yajñam invatu || [10.188.03c]

āyaṁ gauḥ pṛśnir akramīd asadan mātaram puraḥ | [10.189.01a]
pitaraṁ ca prayan svaḥ || [10.189.01c]

antaś carati rocanāsya prāṇād apānatī | [10.189.02a]
vy akhyan mahiṣo divam || [10.189.02c]

triṁśad dhāma vi rājati vāk pataṁgāya dhīyate | [10.189.03a]
prati vastor aha dyubhiḥ || [10.189.03c]

ṛtaṁ ca satyaṁ cābhīddhāt tapaso 'dhy ajāyata | [10.190.01a]
tato rātry ajāyata tataḥ samudro arṇavaḥ || [10.190.01c]

samudrād arṇavād adhi saṁvatsaro ajāyata | [10.190.02a]
ahorātrāṇi vidadhad viśvasya miṣato vaśī || [10.190.02c]

sūryācandramasau dhātā yathāpūrvam akalpayat | [10.190.03a]
divaṁ ca pṛthivīṁ cāntarikṣam atho svaḥ || [10.190.03c]

saṁ-sam id yuvase vṛṣann agne viśvāny arya ā | [10.191.01a]
iḻas pade sam idhyase sa no vasūny ā bhara || [10.191.01c]

saṁ gacchadhvaṁ saṁ vadadhvaṁ saṁ vo manāṁsi jānatām | [10.191.02a]
devā bhāgaṁ yathā pūrve saṁjānānā upāsate || [10.191.02c]

samāno mantraḥ samitiḥ samānī samānam manaḥ saha cittam eṣām | [10.191.03a]
samānam mantram abhi mantraye vaḥ samānena vo haviṣā juhomi || [10.191.03c]

samānī va ākūtiḥ samānā hṛdayāni vaḥ | [10.191.04a]
samānam astu vo mano yathā vaḥ susahāsati || [10.191.04c]
